# Quillwend pricing — v3 (final)

Author: Maya · Date: 2026-09-08 · Status: final, implements the decisions of the 2026-08-19
pricing review.
Supersedes pricing v1 (2026-06-12). v2 was the working spreadsheet for the review and was never
published.

| Plan | Monthly | Annual (25% off) |
|---|---|---|
| Solo | $6 per month | $54 per year |
| Team | $15 per seat per month | $135 per seat per year |

Free trial: 14 days, no card required (unchanged from v1).

## What changed since v1

1. The annual discount is a flat 25% on every plan, replacing v1's "two months free".
2. Solo annual drops from $60 to $54 per year.
3. Team gets an annual option for the first time.
4. Monthly prices are unchanged.

Jonah updates the pricing page copy from this document, not from v1.
